ticket.title: Fix tile caching, duplicate DEM sources, source cache eviction on mode/theme toggle, and tile request storms
ticket.description: Deduplicate raster-dem-terrain and raster-dem-hillshade-src sources and cap Mapterhorn DEM maxzoom to 12 in MapLibreTerrainHelper; stop destroying and recreating base tile sources/layers when the tile URL has not changed across 2D/3D mode or light/dark theme switches; expand {s} subdomains in MapLibreMapEngine.addRaster; configure keepBuffer, updateWhenIdle, and maxTileCacheSize; lazy-load RainViewer and evict non-adjacent radar frame layers; throttle ChaseCameraManager camera animations; and use a valid glyph fontstack for demotiles.maplibre.org.

verification_receipt.summary: [window: no base commit could be named, so this receipt covers HEAD only]
